verses.geez: ወእደ፡ ተናገረ፡ ኢዮብ፡ ወተሰጥወ።
verses.translation: Then Job answered and said,

translations.lxx: Then Job answered and said,
translations.kjv: Then Job answered and said,
translations.ron: Atunci Iov a început să vorbească şi a zis:

verses.geez: ወይቤ፡ እስከ፡ ምንትኑ፡ ታሄፅርዋ፡ ለነፍስየ፡ ወትተትሉኒ፡ በነገርኩ።
verses.translation: How long will ye vex my soul, and destroy me with words? only know that the Lord has dealt with me thus.

translations.lxx: How long will ye vex my soul, and destroy me with words? only know that the Lord has dealt with me thus.
translations.kjv: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?
translations.ron: "Câtă vreme veţi întrista voi sufletul meu şi mă veţi zdrobi cu cuvântările voastre?

verses.geez: አእምሩ፡ ዳዕሙ፡ ከመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘንተ፡ ረሰየኒ፡ ዐሥረ፡ ጊዜያተ፡ ትትናገሩኒ፡ ወኢተኃፍሩ፡ ትቁሙ፡ ላፅለ፡ ነፍስየ።
verses.translation: Ye speak against me; ye do not feel for me, but bear hard upon me.

translations.lxx: Ye speak against me; ye do not feel for me, but bear hard upon me.
translations.kjv: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.
translations.ron: Iată a zecea oară de când mă batjocoriţi. Nu vă este ruşine că vă purtaţi aşa?

verses.geez: ወኦሆ፡ አማን፡ እንከ፡ አበለኩ፡ አነ፡ ወኅቤየ፡ ኃደረት፡ ፅበድ፡ ወነበብኩ፡ ዘኢየአምር፡ ቃለ፡ ወነገርየኒ፡ ዕበድ፡ ወአኮለ፡ ዘአዘለፍ።
verses.translation: Yea verily, I have erred in truth, (but the error abides with myself)

translations.lxx: in having spoken words which it was not right to speak; and my words err, and are unseasonable.
translations.kjv: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
translations.ron: Chiar dacă ar fi adevărat că am păcătuit, greşeala mea este pe capul meu.

verses.geez: አሌ፡ ሊተ፡ በላዕሌየ፡ ዳዕሙ፡ ታአብዩ፡ አፉከሙ፡ ዘሆከኒ፡ ወትትቈናደዩ፡ ብየ፡ ወትዘረከዩኒ።
verses.translation: But alas! for ye magnify yourselves against me, and insult me with reproach.

translations.lxx: But alas! for ye magnify yourselves against me, and insult me with reproach.
translations.kjv: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:
translations.ron: Iar dacă voi vă faceţi tari şi mari împotriva mea şi-mi scoateţi ochii cu ticăloşia mea,

verses.geez: አእምሩ፡ ዳዕሙ፡ ከመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘሆከኒ፡ ወአንኅ፡ መዓቶ፡ ላዕሌየ።
verses.translation: Know then that it is the Lord that has troubled me, and has raised his bulwark against me.

translations.lxx: Know then that it is the Lord that has troubled me, and has raised his bulwark against me.
translations.kjv: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.
translations.ron: Să ştii că Dumnezeu este Cel ce mă urmăreşte şi că El m-a învăluit cu laţul Său.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ እሠርኅ፡ በኂስ፡ ወአነግር፡ ወአወዩ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይፈትሕ፡ ሊተ።
verses.translation: Behold, I laugh at reproach; I will not speak: or I will cry out, but there is nowhere judgment.

translations.lxx: Behold, I laugh at reproach; I will not speak: or I will cry out, but there is nowhere judgment.
translations.kjv: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.
translations.ron: Dacă strig de multa-apăsare, nu primesc nici un răspuns; ţip în gura mare, dar nimeni nu-mi face dreptate.

verses.geez: ወተሐዕረ፡ ዓውድየ፡ ወአልብየ፡ ምኅላፍ፡ ወአንጦልህ፡ ውስተ፡ ገጽየ፡ ጽልመት።
verses.translation: I am fenced round about, and can by no means escape: he has set darkness before my face.

translations.lxx: I am fenced round about, and can by no means escape: he has set darkness before my face.
translations.kjv: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
translations.ron: El a astupat calea mea, ca să nu mai trec pe ea, şi a acoperit cu beznă toate drumurile mele.

verses.geez: ወሰለበኒ፡ ትርሢትየ፡ ወአልብየ፡ አክልየ፡ አምላዕለ፡ ርእስየ።
verses.translation: And he has stripped me of my glory, and has taken the crown from my head.

translations.lxx: And he has stripped me of my glory, and has taken the crown from my head.
translations.kjv: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
translations.ron: M-a dezbrăcat de mărirea mea şi mi-a smuls cununa de pe cap.

verses.geez: ወመሐወኒ፡ እንተ፡ ኵለሄ፡ አሐውር፡ ወአልሕስ፡ ወገዘማ፡ ከመ፡ ዕፅ፡ ለሕይወትየ።
verses.translation: He has torn me round about, and I am gone: and he has cut off my hope like a tree.

translations.lxx: He has torn me round about, and I am gone: and he has cut off my hope like a tree.
translations.kjv: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
translations.ron: M-a dărâmat de jur împrejur şi sunt în ceasul morţii şi nădejdea mea a scos-o din rădăcină ca pe un copac.

verses.geez: ወረሰየኒ፡ ለኃይል፡ መቅሠፍት፡ ወረሰየኒ፡ ከመ፡ ፀር።
verses.translation: And he has dreadfully handled me in anger, and has counted me for an enemy.

translations.lxx: And he has dreadfully handled me in anger, and has counted me for an enemy.
translations.kjv: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.
translations.ron: Aprins-a împotriva mea mânia Sa şi m-a luat drept duşmanul Său.

verses.geez: ወኅቡረ፡ መጽአ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ መዓቱ፡ ወሀገቱኒ፡ ወስተ፡ ፍናውየ፡ እለ፡ ይጸንሑኒ።
verses.translation: His troops also came upon me with one accord, liers in wait compassed my ways.

translations.lxx: His troops also came upon me with one accord, liers in wait compassed my ways.
translations.kjv: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
translations.ron: Hoardele Sale sosesc grămadă, îşi fac drum până la mine şi pun tabără de jur împrejurul cortului meu.

verses.geez: ወአኃውየኒ፡ ተናከሩኒ፡ ወአብደሩ፡ ነኪር፡ እምኔየ፡ አፅርክትየኒ፡ ኢመሐሩኒ።
verses.translation: My brethren have stood aloof from me; they have recognised strangers rather than me: and my friends have become pitiless.

translations.lxx: My brethren have stood aloof from me; they have recognised strangers rather than me: and my friends have become pitiless.
translations.kjv: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
translations.ron: A depărtat pe fraţii mei de lângă mine şi cunoscuţii mei îşi întorc faţa când mă văd.

verses.geez: ወአዝማድየኒ፡ ኢያንከሩስ፡ አለሂ፡ የአምሩ፡ ስምየ፡ ረስሁኒ።
verses.translation: My nearest of kin have not acknowledged me, and they that knew my name, have forgotten me.

translations.lxx: My nearest of kin have not acknowledged me, and they that knew my name, have forgotten me.
translations.kjv: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
translations.ron: Rudele mele au pierit, casnicii mei au uitat de mine.

verses.geez: ወእለሂ፡ ቅሩባንየ፡ ኢይፈቅዱ፡ ይርአዩኒ፡ ወከመ፡ ዘአምከልአ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ይመስሉኒ።
verses.translation: As for my household, and my maid-servants, I was a stranger before them.

translations.lxx: As for my household, and my maid-servants, I was a stranger before them.
translations.kjv: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
translations.ron: Cei ce locuiau împreună cu mine şi slujnicele mele se uită la mine ca la un străin; sunt în ochii lor ca unul venit din altă ţară.

verses.geez: ለነበርየኒ፡ አጼውፆሙ፡ ወይጸመሙኒ።
verses.translation: I called my servant, and he hearkened not; and my mouth intreated him.

translations.lxx: I called my servant, and he hearkened not; and my mouth intreated him.
translations.kjv: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
translations.ron: Chem pe sluga mea şi nu-mi răspunde, măcar că o rog cu gura mea.

verses.geez: ወለብአሲትየኒ፡ አትጋነይ፡ ላቲ፡ ወእዮውሃ፡ ወትትቃፀበኒ፡ ወአስተበቊፆሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ገዛአየ፡ ወአስተምሕር፡ ሎሙ።
verses.translation: And I besought my wife, and earnestly intreated the sons of my concubines.

translations.lxx: And I besought my wife, and earnestly intreated the sons of my concubines.
translations.kjv: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children’s sake of mine own body.
translations.ron: Suflarea mea a ajuns nesuferită pentru femeia mea şi am ajuns să miros greu pentru fiii cei născuţi din coapsele mele.

verses.geez: ወቀብዑኒ፡ ለዓለም፡ ወሶበሂ፡ እትነሣአ፡ የሐምዩኒ።
verses.translation: But they rejected me for ever; whenever I rise up, they speak against me.

translations.lxx: But they rejected me for ever; whenever I rise up, they speak against me.
translations.kjv: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
translations.ron: Până şi copiii îmi arată dispreţ; când mă scol, vorbesc pe seama mea.

verses.geez: ወእለሂ፡ የአምሩኒ፡ ያስቈርሩኒ፡ እለሂ፡ አፈቅሮሙ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ተንሥኡ፡ ላዕለ፡ ነፍስየ፡፡ 20፡ ወይትቤጸል፡ ማእፀየ፡ ምስለ፡ ሥጋየ፡ ወየሐቅየኒ፡ አዕፅ፡ ምትየ።
verses.translation: They that saw me abhorred me: the very persons whom I had loved, rose up against me.

translations.lxx: They that saw me abhorred me: the very persons whom I had loved, rose up against me.
translations.kjv: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.
translations.ron: Toţi sfetnicii mei cei mai de aproape mă urgisesc şi aceia pe care îi iubeam s-au întors împotriva mea.

verses.geez: መሐሩኒ፡ መሐሩኒ፡ አዕርክትየ፡ እስመ፡ እደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውእሩ፡ ዘገሠሠኒ።
verses.translation: Pity me, pity me, O friends; for it is the hand of the Lord that has touched me.

translations.lxx: Pity me, pity me, O friends; for it is the hand of the Lord that has touched me.
translations.kjv: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.
translations.ron: Milă fie-vă de mine, aveţi milă de mine, o, voi, prietenii mei, căci mâna lui Dumnezeu m-a lovit!

verses.geez: ወለምንት፡ እንትሙ፡ ታሠርሑኒ፡ ከመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወኢትጸግቡኑ፡ እምሥጋየ።
verses.translation: Wherefore do ye persecute me as also the Lord does, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

translations.lxx: Wherefore do ye persecute me as also the Lord does, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
translations.kjv: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
translations.ron: De ce mă prigoniţi cu urgia lui Dumnezeu şi nu vă mai săturaţi de carnea mea?

verses.geez: መኑ፡ እምጸሐፎኑ፡ ለነገርየ፡ ወይልክዖ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ዘለዓለም።
verses.translation: For oh that my words were written, and that they were recorded in a book for ever,

translations.lxx: For oh that my words were written, and that they were recorded in a book for ever,
translations.kjv: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
translations.ron: Cit aş vrea ca vorbele mele să fie scrise, cât aş vrea să fie săpate pe aramă.

verses.geez: ውስተ፡ ምጽሐለ፡ ሐፂን፡ ወአረር፡ ወእመ፡ እኮ፡ ይግልፍዎ፡ ውስተ፡ ኰኵሕ።
verses.translation: with an iron pen and lead, or graven in the rocks!

translations.lxx: with an iron pen and lead, or graven in the rocks!
translations.kjv: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
translations.ron: Să fie săpate pe veci, cu un condei de fier şi de plumb, într-o stâncă!

verses.geez: አእምር፡ ባሕቱ፡ ከመ፡ ኢያገምሮ፡ ቤት፡ ለዠለህዎ፡ ይፈውሰኒ፡ ሕያው፡ ዘይቀውም፡ ድኅረ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: For I know that he is eternal who is about to deliver me,

translations.lxx: For I know that he is eternal who is about to deliver me,
translations.kjv: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
translations.ron: Dar eu ştiu că Răscumpărătorul meu este viu şi că El, în ziua cea de pe urmă, va ridica iar din pulbere această piele a mea ce se destramă.

verses.geez: ወእንዘ፡ ሀሎኩ፡ ዓዲ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ዝኒ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ መጽአኒ።
verses.translation: and to raise up upon the earth my skin that endures these sufferings: for these things have been accomplished to me of the Lord;

translations.lxx: and to raise up upon the earth my skin that endures these sufferings: for these things have been accomplished to me of the Lord;
translations.kjv: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:
translations.ron: Şi afară din trupul meu voi vedea pe Dumnezeu.

verses.geez: ወይትዌላጥ፡ ማአስየ፡ ዘለልየ፡ አእምር፡ ዘዓይንየ፡ ርእየት፡ ወአኮ፡ ባዕድ፡ ሠለጡኒ፡ ኵሎ፡ ውስተ፡ ሕፅንየ።
verses.translation: which I am conscious of in myself, which mine eye has seen, and not another, but all have been fulfilled to me in my bosom.

translations.lxx: which I am conscious of in myself, which mine eye has seen, and not another, but all have been fulfilled to me in my bosom.
translations.kjv: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.
translations.ron: Pe El Îl voi vedea şi ochii mei Îl vor privi, nu ai altuia. Şi de dorul acesta măruntaiele mele tânjesc în mine.

verses.geez: እመሳ፡ ትብሉ፡ ምንተ፡ ንነግር፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ወንረከብ፡ ሥርወ፡ ነገር፡ ሎቱ፡ ፍርህዋ፡ ለኃሣር፡ እንትሙኒ።
verses.translation: But if ye shall also say, What shall we say before him, and so find the root of the matter in him?

translations.lxx: But if ye shall also say, What shall we say before him, and so find the root of the matter in him?
translations.kjv: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
translations.ron: Iar dacă ziceţi: Cum îl vom urmări şi ce pricină de proces vom găsi noi în el?

verses.geez: እስ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ ትመጽኦሙ፡ ለኃጥአን፡ ወአሜሃ፡ የአምሩ፡ ኵሎ፡ እከዮሙ፡ እምአይቴ፡ ዘበጽሖሙ።
verses.translation: Do ye also beware of deceit: for wrath will come upon transgressors; and then shall they know where their substance is.

translations.lxx: Do ye also beware of deceit: for wrath will come upon transgressors; and then shall they know where their substance is.
translations.kjv: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.
translations.ron: Temeţi-vă de sabie, pentru voi înşivă, când mânia va izbucni împotriva greşelii voastre. Şi atunci veţi învăţa că este o judecată!"
